trans-unit.target: Pantalones Capri (también conocido como pantalones de tres cuartos, capris, pantalones de cultivo, empujadores del pedal, cavadores de la almeja, pantalones de inundación, "jams", aguas altas, culottes o pantalones de torero) son los pantalones más largos que los pantalones cortos, pero no tan largos como los pantalones largos.

Los pantalones son una prenda de vestir que se lleva desde la cintura hasta los tobillos, cubriendo ambas piernas por separado (en lugar de cubrirlas con un paño que se extiende a través de ambas piernas, como en túnicas, faldas y vestidos).

trans-unit.id: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.source: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.target: La generación de contaminación aérea se divide entre esta cantidad para determinar los ppm de contaminación. Este valor dependerá del parámetro AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 ('presión atmosférica en kg/m2') y el área del mundo. para 1 km2 de terreno y una presión de 1 kg/m2, 1 ton = 1 ppm (parte por millón), que es la unidad que determina los efectos en el cambio climático.

trans-unit.id: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.source: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.target: Cantidad que será añadida/eliminada a/de la atmósfera por tonelada de material empleado (por ejemplo, CO2) (en ppm).

trans-unit.id: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.source: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.target: Presión atmosférica usada en la fórmula del tamaño de atmósfera. Los árboles absorben cualquier fuente de contaminación de las tablas, expresada en toneladas y convertida a ppm al dividirla entre el tamaño total de la atmósfera. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). Por ejemplo, para un mundo de 1 km² (1000000 m²) con una presión atmosférica de 1 kg/m², se obtendrán 1000000 tons, es decir 1 ppm por ton de contaminación o absorción (1 ppm = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons). Si aumentáramos la presión a 2, obtendríamos 0.5 ppm/ton.

A los alumnos que tengan una formación parcial al incorporarse se les cobrará una matrícula proporcional.

trans-unit.id: Max count of records that will be proccesed at once hourly. For reference, server with 100 players may reach 1.000.000 records per day. Usually 500.000 (default) should be ok, but you may want to tweak it if you have incredibly big count of records or if you are facing lag while it groups records.
trans-unit.source: Max count of records that will be proccesed at once hourly. For reference, server with 100 players may reach 1.000.000 records per day. Usually 500.000 (default) should be ok, but you may want to tweak it if you have incredibly big count of records or if you are facing lag while it groups records.
trans-unit.target: El número máximo de registros que se procesarán a la vez por hora. A modo de referencia, los servidores con 100 jugadores pueden alcanzar 1.000.000 de registros al día. Normalmente (por defecto), esto debería estar bien, pero es posible que desee cambiar esto si tiene un recuento de registros increíblemente grande o si experimenta retraso al agrupar los registros.

trans-unit.id: Most recent records wont be processed in order to have more exact values for laws like 'Users who in last 1 hour claimed plots ...'. You may want to tweak this value to increase this support.
trans-unit.source: Most recent records wont be processed in order to have more exact values for laws like 'Users who in last 1 hour claimed plots ...'. You may want to tweak this value to increase this support.
trans-unit.target: Los registros más recientes no se procesarán para tener valores más precisos para leyes como "Usuarios que en la última hora han reclamado lotes...". Es posible que desee ajustar este valor para aumentar esta ayuda.

trans-unit.id: It rebuilds database file at the moment of exiting the application. It may reduce space of stats file, but it will increase the time needed to exit.
trans-unit.source: It rebuilds database file at the moment of exiting the application. It may reduce space of stats file, but it will increase the time needed to exit.
trans-unit.target: Esto reconstruye el archivo de la base de datos en el momento en que se sale de la aplicación. Esto puede reducir el espacio del archivo de estadísticas, pero aumentará el tiempo necesario para salir.

trans-unit.id: Level of grouping data. Essential fields means only citizen, i.e, it may group action of 'drop rubble' and 'drop garbage' for same citizen. Currently othey fields are not used, so it should be good enough. But in the future there are may be another features with database, which may requiere another properties.
trans-unit.source: Level of grouping data. Essential fields means only citizen, i.e, it may group action of 'drop rubble' and 'drop garbage' for same citizen. Currently othey fields are not used, so it should be good enough. But in the future there are may be another features with database, which may requiere another properties.
trans-unit.target: Nivel de agrupación de datos. Los campos esenciales indican sólo a los ciudadanos, por ejemplo, podría agrupar la acción de "tirar escombros" y "tirar basura" para algunos ciudadanos. Actualmente los otros campos no se utilizan, por lo que debería ser bastante bueno. Pero en el futuro, puede haber otra funcionalidad con la base de datos, que puede requerir otras propiedades.

Generally tax rates on transfers between two accounts you both own is zero, but this tax rate can be set to prevent tax evasion by changing ownership of bank accounts after a transfer.
trans-unit.target: Es un impuesto que se cobra a los ciudadanos que transfieren divisas de su cuenta a otra a la que tienen acceso. Por lo general, el tipo impositivo sobre las transferencias entre dos cuentas de las que ambos son propietarios es cero, pero este tipo impositivo puede establecerse para evitar la evasión fiscal mediante el cambio de titularidad de las cuentas bancarias después de una transferencia.

trans-unit.source: A tax taken from citizens when using a currency exchange. Tax is charged as an extra cost to the customer, and the given percent is taken from both currencies in the transaction (thus you may want this to half of what you want the expected tax percent to be, since both are taxed).
trans-unit.target: Impuesto que se cobra a los ciudadanos cuando se utiliza un cambio de moneda. trans-unit.source: An ashlar stone bench. Great for display though maybe not as comfy as a padded couch.
trans-unit.target: Un banco de piedra de sillería. Es ideal para exhibirlo, aunque quizá no sea tan cómodo como un sofá acolchado.

trans-unit.id: A fancy ashlar stone table that has been adorned with gold.
trans-unit.source: A fancy ashlar stone table that has been adorned with gold.
trans-unit.target: Una elegante mesa de sillar de piedra que ha sido adornada con oro.

trans-unit.id: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.source: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.target: Todos los ciudadanos son supervivientes en el mundo de Eco. ¿Acaso puedes salvar al mundo sin poder salvarte a ti mismo?

trans-unit.id: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: El metal es una parte importante del progreso y la fundición es el primer paso hacia una nueva era. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.source: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.target: La superación personal aumenta tanto la cantidad de peso que los ciudadanos pueden llevar como su capacidad estomacal. También disminuye las calorías gastadas al utilizar martillos y palas. Se gana experiencia al subir de nivel otras especialidades.

trans-unit.id: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La cerámica es una mejora de mampostería que permite obtener materiales de gran calidad para tus comunidades. Mejora su nivel creando recetas asociadas.

trans-unit.id: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Habilidad para la creación y uso del papel, con el que escribir textos o para otras cosas que se colocan en estanterías. Mejora su nivel creando recetas asociadas a esta habilidad.

trans-unit.id: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Aunque necesita algunas construcciones y herramientas avanzadas, esta habilidad para la extracción y el refinado de petróleo es un paso importante para tu sociedad. Mejora su nivel creando recetas asociadas a esta habilidad.

trans-unit.id: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.source: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.target: Golpear las rocas con un pico puede ser sorprendentemente difícil. Sube de nivel rompiendo rocas.

trans-unit.id: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La molienda de varios productos puede crear materiales importantes para la repostería y otros usos. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Habilidad para el desarrollo de la mecánica, con la que poder mejorar tu fabricación. Mejora su nivel creando recetas asociadas a esta habilidad.

trans-unit.id: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Las rocas y el mortero pueden proporcionar un material de construcción adecuado como alternativa a la madera. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.source: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.target: La madera es un recurso útil y cortar árboles es una habilidad que cualquiera puede apreciar. Sube de nivel talando árboles y limpiando los escombros.

trans-unit.id: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Habilidad de industrialización avanzada que permite la fabricación de máquinas más grandes y de tecnología de última generación. Mejora su nivel creando recetas asociadas a esta habilidad.

trans-unit.id: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.source: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.target: Caza animales para obtener piel y carne. Sube de nivel cazando con éxito.

trans-unit.id: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Los vidrieros han mejorado la capacidad de crear vidrio que puede utilizarse como material de construcción transparente o enmarcado en acero para crear un aspecto más industrial. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.source: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.target: La recolección abarca la recogida de materiales tanto del entorno natural como de las granjas creadas por el hombre. Sube de nivel recolectando plantas, cultivadas o naturales.

trans-unit.id: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Añadir nutrientes adicionales a la tierra puede mejorar el rendimiento de la agricultura o, si se exagera, arruinarlo. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.source: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.target: El arte de plantar y cultivar la flora. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas y utilizando la azada.

trans-unit.id: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La electrónica mejora las recetas de muchos materiales avanzados necesarios para la tecnología avanzada. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La cocina de vanguardia trabaja con ingredientes que no parecen comida pero que pueden aportar muchas calorías y nutrientes. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Los fundamentos de la cocina en un entorno más civilizado dan bonificaciones a una variedad de recetas de comida. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Permite la construcción de productos de madera avanzados para muebles y casas. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Cortar troncos para convertirlos en materiales utilizables para la artesanía y la construcción es una habilidad importante para las comunidades en ciernes. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.target: Técnicas avanzadas para elaborar comida en una hoguera con un poco menos de quemado y un poco más de dorado. Sube de nivel elaborando recetas de fogata relacionadas.

trans-unit.id: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La carnicería permite recolectar más productos utilizables a partir de animales y peces cazados. Sube de nivel creando recetas asociadas.

trans-unit.id: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.

trans-unit.id: Advanced smelting aids in the production of steel - a key ingredient in the progress of any group. Levels up by crafting advanced smelting recipes.

trans-unit.id: This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. trans-unit.source: This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.\n\nIf you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. trans-unit.id: Your GPU's Max Tessellation Level is less than 64. AMD is the only known GPU manufacturer who doesn't follow the standard and reduces this setting to hack performance in their "AMD Radeon Software", setting it to 8 in the default optimized settings. You may experience problems with the Minimap rendering. To fix this, set "Max Tessellation Level" to 64 in the software for Eco (explicitly) and restart the game.
trans-unit.source: Your GPU's Max Tessellation Level is less than 64. AMD is the only known GPU manufacturer who doesn't follow the standard and reduces this setting to hack performance in their "AMD Radeon Software", setting it to 8 in the default optimized settings. You may experience problems with the Minimap rendering. To fix this, set "Max Tessellation Level" to 64 in the software for Eco (explicitly) and restart the game.
trans-unit.target: Tu GPU tiene un nivel de teselado máximo menor de 64. AMD es el único fabricante de GPUs que no sigue los estándares en estos sistemas, reduciendo este ajuste para "engañar" al rendimiento con su AMD Radeon Software, empleando un valor de 8 en sus ajustes optimizados por defecto. Podrías tener problemas con el renderizado del minimapa si mantienes estos ajustes. Para corregirlo, se recomienda cambiar el "Nivel máximo de teselado" a 64 en el software de Eco (de forma explícita) y reiniciar el juego.

trans-unit.id: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.source: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.target: Este ajuste defina como las plantas serían grupadas cuando genera el mundo. Tiene dos niveles de agrupación: agrupaciones y grupos. Una agrupación es una zona grande del mundo donde existe un tipo específico de planta, y afecta el modo de juego por limitando donde plantas específicas se puede engendrar. Los grupos son principalmentes con fines visuales, así que plantas del mismo especíes crecen juntas sólo una distancia pequena entrelas.

trans-unit.id: A clever and adaptable canid with a bushy tail and distinctive howling and yipping vocalizations. Known for their scavenging and hunting abilities, coyotes can be found in many different habitats.

trans-unit.id: A massive, shaggy mammal with a large head, humped shoulders, and distinctive curved horns. Often seen grazing on grasslands and prairies, bison are an important example of a species that has made a remarkable comeback from the brink of extinction due to conservation efforts.
trans-unit.source: A massive, shaggy mammal with a large head, humped shoulders, and distinctive curved horns. Often seen grazing on grasslands and prairies, bison are an important example of a species that has made a remarkable comeback from the brink of extinction due to conservation efforts.
trans-unit.target: Un mamífero enorme y de pelaje greñudo con una gran cabeza, hombros jorobados y característicos cuernos curvados. Visto a menudo pastando en praderas y estepas, el bisonte es un ejemplo importante de una especie que ha logrado recuperarse de forma asombrosa del borde de la extinción gracias a los esfuerzos de conservación.

trans-unit.id: These wild ungulates are known for their distinctive curved horns, which are used for dominance battles and display during the mating season. They are well adapted to harsh environments and are found in both mountainous and desert regions.

Están perfectamente adaptados a entornos hostiles y se encuentran tanto en regiones montañosas como desérticas.

trans-unit.id: A large, scaly reptile with a powerful bite and a long tail, commonly found near rivers, swamps, and lakes in warm regions. Alligators are ancient creatures that have remained virtually unchanged for millions of years.

trans-unit.id: Children Settlements May Annex Each Other

trans-unit.id: Citizens can submit settlement citizenship applications if enabled. If disabled, citizenship is only attainable through invitation.
trans-unit.source: Citizens can submit settlement citizenship applications if enabled. If disabled, citizenship is only attainable through invitation.
trans-unit.target: Los ciudadanos pueden presentar solicitudes de ciudadanía en los asentamientos si esta opción está habilitada. Si está deshabilitada, solo se puede obtener la ciudadanía mediante invitación.

trans-unit.id: When new Citizens are permitted, settlement requirements must be met to apply. Enabling 'Allow New People To Instantly Join' allows immediate joining for new Citizens.
trans-unit.source: When new Citizens are permitted, settlement requirements must be met to apply. Enabling 'Allow New People To Instantly Join' allows immediate joining for new Citizens.
trans-unit.target: Cuando se permiten nuevos ciudadanos, hay que cumplir los requisitos de asentamiento para poder solicitarlos. Al activar «Permitir que se unan personas nuevas al instante», los nuevos ciudadanos pueden unirse de inmediato.

trans-unit.id: Citizens possessing the authority to approve citizenship applications. If vacant, applications are automatically approved.
trans-unit.source: Citizens possessing the authority to approve citizenship applications. If vacant, applications are automatically approved.
trans-unit.target: Los ciudadanos tienen la autoridad para aprobar las solicitudes de ciudadanía. Si el puesto está vacante, las solicitudes se aprueban automáticamente.

trans-unit.id: Citizens failing to meet ongoing requirements are granted time for compliance. Failure to meet requirements post-deadline results in citizenship revocation.
trans-unit.source: Citizens failing to meet ongoing requirements are granted time for compliance. Failure to meet requirements post-deadline results in citizenship revocation.
trans-unit.target: A los ciudadanos que no cumplan los requisitos vigentes se les concede un plazo para regularizar su situación. Si no cumplen los requisitos tras la fecha límite, se les revoca la ciudadanía.

trans-unit.id: A feature determining whether brand new Citizens can spawn in the settlement. If allowed, they instantly become citizens of the settlement they spawn in.

trans-unit.target: Una función que determina si pueden aparecer nuevos ciudadanos en el asentamiento. Si se permite, se convierten al instante en ciudadanos del asentamiento en el que aparecen.

trans-unit.id: A feature deciding whether Citizens can start new children settlements within the current settlement.

Limita las horas de juego al día

trans-unit.id: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.source: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.target: Una vez configurado, los ciudadanos se agotarán tras un número determinado de horas. Mientras estén agotados, no pueden gastar calorías, pero sí pueden realizar otras actividades, como crear cultura, etc. Esta configuración se utiliza para evitar que algunos jugadores se adelanten al resto jugando muchas más horas que los demás.

trans-unit.id: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.source: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.target: Número previsto de jugadores que contribuirán a la misión del meteorito. Ajustar este valor cambiará el número de especialidades que cada persona puede elegir (dependiendo del nivel de colaboración).

trans-unit.id: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.source: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.target: ¿En qué medida se espera que los ciudadanos colaboren? Una alta colaboración significa que todos dependerán en gran medida de que la sociedad funcione correctamente. La falta de colaboración significa que no se requiere dependencia, pero aún así se puede comerciar.

trans-unit.id: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.source: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.target: ¿Con qué rigor quieres simular aspectos logísticos como el transporte, la capacidad de carga, etc.? Unos ajustes más altos harán que el transporte sea más importante (necesitarás vehículos para mover grandes cantidades) y unos ajustes más bajos permitirán a las personas transportar grandes cantidades, eliminando la necesidad de vehículos.

trans-unit.id: As research progresses, new vehicle types will be unlocked that can transport, harvest, plow, and mine in large quantities.
trans-unit.source: As research progresses, new vehicle types will be unlocked that can transport, harvest, plow, and mine in large quantities.
trans-unit.target: A medida que avance la investigación, se desbloquearán nuevos tipos de vehículos capaces de transportar, cosechar, arar y extraer minerales en grandes cantidades.

trans-unit.id: Citizens who specialize in Engineering will be able to build new vehicles, roads, and ramps, making long-distance transport easier.
trans-unit.source: Citizens who specialize in Engineering will be able to build new vehicles, roads, and ramps, making long-distance transport easier.
trans-unit.target: Los ciudadanos especializados en ingeniería podrán construir nuevos vehículos, carreteras y rampas, lo que facilitará el transporte de larga distancia.

trans-unit.id: Citizens specialize in different skills and need to trade with other specialists to acquire what they need.
trans-unit.source: Citizens specialize in different skills and need to trade with other specialists to acquire what they need.
trans-unit.target: Los ciudadanos se especializan en diferentes habilidades y necesitan intercambiar con otros especialistas para conseguir lo que necesitan.

trans-unit.id: The economy viewer will show you all the active trades in the world, as well as Work Parties, Contracts, Rental Offers, Repair Bounties, and more.
trans-unit.source: The economy viewer will show you all the active trades in the world, as well as Work Parties, Contracts, Rental Offers, Repair Bounties, and more.
trans-unit.target: El visor de economía te mostrará todos los intercambios activos en el mundo, así como grupos de trabajo, contratos, ofertas de alquiler, recompensas por reparaciones y mucho más.

trans-unit.id: Use it to buy and sell both goods and services to other citizens.
trans-unit.source: Use it to buy and sell both goods and services to other citizens.
trans-unit.target: Úsalos para comprar y vender bienes y servicios a otros ciudadanos.

trans-unit.id: An economy can thrive much better if citizens use a common currency, so this is a good goal to work towards as a group.
trans-unit.source: An economy can thrive much better if citizens use a common currency, so this is a good goal to work towards as a group.
trans-unit.target: La economía puede prosperar mucho mejor si los ciudadanos usan una moneda común, así que este es un buen objetivo por el que trabajar en equipo.
Este producto tiene variaciones de recetas.

trans-unit.id: Determines animal attack pattern. Set to none to completely disable aggressiveness.

trans-unit.id: Multiplier applied to fuel yield per unit. Values above one make fuel last longer, below 1 make fuel last shorter. A server restart is required for correct calculation.

trans-unit.target: Multiplicador aplicado al rendimiento de combustible por unidad. Los valores superiores a uno hacen que el combustible dure más, los inferiores a 1 hacen que dure menos. Es necesario reiniciar el servidor para que el cálculo sea correcto.

trans-unit.id: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. Usually you want to have this number low (1-2) in order to avoid process already processed records, but you can set high value (by example world age) in order to process at once all records from some old save with disabled grouping.
trans-unit.source: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. Usually you want to have this number low (1-2) in order to avoid process already processed records, but you can set high value (by example world age) in order to process at once all records from some old save with disabled grouping.
trans-unit.target: Cómo se pueden agrupar los registros antiguos. Esto significa que intentará procesar todos los registros de los últimos X días para agruparlos. Normalmente, es mejor que este número sea bajo (1-2) para evitar procesar registros que ya se han procesado, pero puedes establecer un valor alto (por ejemplo, la edad del mundo) para procesar de una vez todos los registros de una partida guardada antigua con la agrupación desactivada.

trans-unit.id: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.source: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.target: Dimensiones de los bloques del mundo a lo largo de X-Z. Ambas dimensiones deben tener el mismo valor y ser divisibles por 4. El tamaño del mundo tiene límites, pero estos suelen aplicarse cuando el tamaño del mundo es mayor de 250x250. Si quieres un tamaño mayor —>—, entonces MaxBuildHeight debe ser menor de 320. Ejemplo: el tamaño 300 tiene una altura máxima de 238, el 400 tiene 134, etc.

trans-unit.id: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.source: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.target: Altura máxima a la que los ciudadanos del mundo pueden construir. No se puede reducir después de crear el mundo. Ten en cuenta que los valores superiores a 160 aumentarán considerablemente los recursos de CPU y RAM necesarios para el mundo. Tiene un límite máximo de 320. No debe ser inferior a MaxGenerationHeight. El producto de las dimensiones del mundo ((Longitud * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Ancho * 10)) debe ser menor que el valor máximo si es un entero, por lo que los valores se pueden limitar a un valor inferior al iniciar el servidor.

trans-unit.id: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.source: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.target: Especifica la fórmula o curva que controla la forma en que el audio se atenúa entre la distancia conversacional y la distancia audible. (1:InverseByDistance) - Atenúa la voz rápidamente al principio, pero se ralentiza a medida que te alejas de la distancia conversacional. (2:LinearByDistance) - Atenúa la voz lentamente al principio, pero se acelera a medida que te alejas de la distancia conversacional. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - La voz dentro de la distancia conversacional es más alta, pero se atenúa rápidamente más allá de ella.

trans-unit.id: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.source: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.target: Define cómo varía el porcentaje de penalización entre los valores iniciales y máximos de contaminación. Valores posibles: Lineal (la penalización aumenta de forma uniforme), Exponencial (la penalización aumenta lentamente al principio y luego rápidamente cuando la contaminación es alta), Logarítmica (la penalización es fuerte con poca contaminación y luego se estabiliza con valores más altos), Doble sigmoide (la penalización aumenta mucho con poca contaminación, se ralentiza cerca del rango medio y vuelve a aumentar mucho cerca de la contaminación máxima).

trans-unit.id:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.source:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.target:
Define un conjunto de bloques que deben existir, o no existir, en una propiedad. Esto se puede usar para todo tipo de cosas:
 - Eliminar plantas no deseadas
 - Eliminar la contaminación
 - Plantar campos (los bloques plantados deben existir)
 - Eliminar estructuras u obstáculos.

Si {Text.Info(Surface)} está marcado, solo se examinarán los bloques de superficie. De lo contrario, se examinarán los bloques hasta una profundidad de {Text.Info(5)} por debajo del bloque más alto.

trans-unit.id: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.source: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.target: Esta cláusula permite a los jugadores definir con palabras lo que les gustaría que se hiciera. Al usar esta cláusula, el contrato ya no se puede aprobar automáticamente, y el cliente tendrá que aprobarlo antes de aceptarlo. Al aceptar un contrato con una cláusula personalizada, es recomendable revisar primero la reputación del ciudadano que lo ofrece, ya que queda totalmente a su discreción aprobar o rechazar su cumplimiento.\n\nDebes desmarcar {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} en la parte inferior del contrato para usar esta cláusula.

trans-unit.id: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.source: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.target: Define un contenedor que debe contener un conjunto de objetos. Tanto tú como el contratista debéis tener derechos de acceso al contenedor seleccionado.\n\nPuedes conceder automáticamente al contratista derechos de acceso al contenedor durante la vigencia del contrato mediante una cláusula contractual adicional sobre permisos.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula te permite restringir la aceptación de un contrato solo a aquellos que tengan una reputación igual o superior a la cantidad definida.

Hay dos tipos de reputación que puedes especificar aquí: 
 - Reputación, que es la suma de todas las valoraciones del jugador.
 - Reputación relativa, que es la suma de las opiniones de los jugadores a los que has valorado favorablemente (y a quienes ellos han valorado favorablemente, etc.).

Puedes consultar la reputación de todos los jugadores del servidor a través de la lista de ciudadanos, que muestra a los jugadores ordenados por reputación y muestra las valoraciones de otros jugadores en la descripción emergente de reputación.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.
There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: - {0}, which is the sum of all player's ratings, multiplied by a network effect. - {1}, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).
You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.
There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: - {0}, which is the sum of all player's ratings, multiplied by a network effect. - {1}, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).
You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula te permite restringir la aceptación de un contrato solo a aquellos que tengan una reputación igual o superior a la cantidad definida.
Hay dos tipos de reputación que puedes especificar aquí: - {0}, que es la suma de todas las valoraciones del jugador, multiplicada por un efecto de red. - {1}, que es la suma de las opiniones de los jugadores a los que has valorado favorablemente (y a quienes ellos han valorado favorablemente, etc.).
Puedes consultar la reputación de todos los jugadores del servidor a través de la lista de ciudadanos, que muestra a los jugadores ordenados por reputación y muestra las valoraciones de otros jugadores en la descripción emergente de reputación.

trans-unit.id:
This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.
If you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.source:
This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.
If you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula otorgará al contratista autorización sobre el objeto o propiedad seleccionados. La autorización puede concederse temporalmente durante la vigencia del contrato, o bien de forma permanente. Este permiso puede otorgarse al inicio o al final del contrato.
Si necesitas que un jugador entregue algo en un contenedor privado o construya en un terreno privado, tendrás que establecer sus permisos con esta cláusula para asegurarte de que tiene acceso. Los jugadores que acepten un contrato siempre deben asegurarse de que recibirán los permisos necesarios para llevarlo a cabo.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to define a set of sub-clauses. You can define how many of the sub-classes must be satisfied for this clause to succeed: All, Any, or None.
This clause is useful for making complex requirements with multiple options for success.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to define a set of sub-clauses. You can define how many of the sub-classes must be satisfied for this clause to succeed: All, Any, or None.
This clause is useful for making complex requirements with multiple options for success.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula te permite definir un conjunto de subcláusulas. Puedes definir cuántas de las subcláusulas deben cumplirse para que esta cláusula se cumpla: Todas, Cualquiera o Ninguna.
Esta cláusula es útil para crear requisitos complejos con múltiples opciones para su cumplimiento.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.
You must uncheck {0} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.
You must uncheck {0} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula permite a los jugadores definir con palabras lo que les gustaría que se hiciera. Al usar esta cláusula, el contrato ya no se puede aprobar automáticamente, y el cliente tendrá que aprobarlo antes de aceptarlo. Al aceptar un contrato con una cláusula personalizada, es aconsejable revisar primero la reputación del ciudadano que lo ofrece, ya que queda totalmente a su discreción aprobar o denegar su cumplimiento.
Debes desmarcar {0} (Aceptar el contrato de forma automática) en la parte inferior del contrato para usar esta cláusula.

trans-unit.id: Defines a position where a room must be built, with a minimum volume and made of at least the listed materials. The position is marked by a {0}, and you must place one on the location you want the room built.

trans-unit.id:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things: - Removing unwanted plants - Removing pollution - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist) - Removing structures or obstacles.
If {0} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {1} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.source:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things: - Removing unwanted plants - Removing pollution - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist) - Removing structures or obstacles.
If {0} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {1} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.target:
Define un conjunto de bloques que deben existir, o no existir, en una propiedad. Esto se puede usar para todo tipo de cosas: - Eliminar plantas no deseadas - Eliminar la contaminación - Plantar campos (los bloques plantados deben existir) - Eliminar estructuras u obstáculos.
Si se marca {0}, solo se examinarán los bloques de la superficie. De lo contrario, se examinarán los bloques hasta una profundidad de {1} por debajo del bloque más alto.

trans-unit.id:
This clause provides a payment, with the option of collecting a deposit from the contractor.
Deposits and payments are held in escrow for the duration of the contract. The amount in escrow is given to the contractor if the contract is successfully completed, or it goes to the client if the contract is marked as failed.
trans-unit.source:
This clause provides a payment, with the option of collecting a deposit from the contractor.
Deposits and payments are held in escrow for the duration of the contract. The amount in escrow is given to the contractor if the contract is successfully completed, or it goes to the client if the contract is marked as failed.
trans-unit.target:
Esta cláusula establece un pago, con la opción de cobrar un depósito al contratista.
Los depósitos y los pagos se mantienen en custodia durante la vigencia del contrato. La cantidad en custodia se entrega al contratista si el contrato se completa con éxito, o se entrega al cliente si el contrato se marca como fallido.

trans-unit.id:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.source:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.target:
Para anexionar un objetivo, hay que pagarles los documentos de reclamación desde el asentamiento de origen. A diferencia de los recursos, estos se destinan al 100 % a la fundación del objetivo sin desperdicio. El coste se determina por cada ciudadano no abandonado en el objetivo.
En el caso de anexionar una granja, este número se incrementará por el número de documentos de reclamación de apoyo a la granja que estén en juego. Esto hace que las reclamaciones de apoyo no solo permitan a las granjas reclamar más parcelas, sino que también tengan más protección contra la anexión.

trans-unit.id:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.source:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.target:
Los recursos que se muestran deben estar almacenados en un escritorio de embajada asignado a la jurisdicción del asentamiento. El líder del asentamiento debe poder acceder a ellos. El coste se calcula por cada ciudadano no abandonado del objetivo.
Tras la anexión, un porcentaje de estos se entregará a la otra parte, y el resto se destruirá como coste de la anexión.
Si todos los ciudadanos de un objetivo están «abandonados», no se necesitan recursos.

trans-unit.source:

trans-unit.id:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.source:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.target:
Ten en cuenta que «Integridad» no es lo mismo que «Durabilidad».
La Integridad es la Durabilidad máxima a la que se puede reparar un objeto, y disminuye cada vez que se repara. Al reparar un objeto, su Durabilidad aumenta hasta alcanzar la Integridad actual, pero la Integridad nunca se puede aumentar, solo reducir.

trans-unit.id:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.source:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.target:
Los recursos que se muestran deben estar almacenados en un escritorio de embajada asignado a la jurisdicción del asentamiento. El líder del asentamiento debe poder acceder a ellos.
Tras la anexión, un porcentaje de estos se entregará a la otra parte y el resto se destruirá como coste de la anexión.
Si todos los ciudadanos de un objetivo están «abandonados», no se necesitan recursos.

trans-unit.id: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.
trans-unit.source: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.

trans-unit.id: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.
trans-unit.source: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.

trans-unit.id: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).
trans-unit.source: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).

trans-unit.id: Placed objects (tables, machines, storages) fall into a garbage bag, with all their contents, when the ground under them goes or when falling blocks land on them; the bag can be picked back up. When off, objects stay where they are, even in mid-air, and falling blocks land on top of them.
trans-unit.source: Placed objects (tables, machines, storages) fall into a garbage bag, with all their contents, when the ground under them goes or when falling blocks land on them; the bag can be picked back up. When off, objects stay where they are, even in mid-air, and falling blocks land on top of them.

trans-unit.id: Rock standing on this many rock blocks counts as solid ground, for natural blocks and as an anchor for constructions: only the layers of rock just above a void can cave in, so a cave too wide brings down a slab this thick, then the next one over a narrower opening, until it settles into a vault, instead of the whole mountain above it. Loose ground never counts. 0: only rock in an unbroken column from bedrock is ground.

Loose ground never counts. 0: only rock in an unbroken column from bedrock is ground.
